title: feat(spec)!: defineStack refuses a declared webhook whose requires lacks webhooks or realtime (STACK_WEBHOOK_CAPABILITY_REQUIRED)
body:
Fixes #24997

Refs #24910

Clause-②: no (narrowing: a stack declaring a webhook without the capability tokens is refused; ships now under the amended 「甲」, #6015 `6303865025`)

## What the ruling binds

Ruling A on #24910 (record `6303779439`, amended by `6303859748`: 「暂时不考虑 v19，协议的调整原则上也是尽快，不考虑退役版本。」), as the card states it:

> - `defineStack` refuses a stack that declares a webhook while `requires` lacks `'webhooks'` or `'realtime'`, with ONE code for every arm, `STACK_WEBHOOK_CAPABILITY_REQUIRED`, in the `STACK_*` family beside `STACK_TRIGGER_CAPABILITY_REQUIRED` (`packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts:3263`, #20332): which token is missing is in the finding, not in the code. Registered in `packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts`.
> - Every door that loads a stack refuses with the same sentence: `os validate`, `os build`, `os serve` / `os dev`, an app's own `bootStack` tests, the cloud runtime. The boot `error` of PR #24946 (`19e5338cc8`) stays for a host that wires a stack by hand.
> - **Measure first, at claim:** cloud's `resolveCapabilityDependencies` for `webhooks` (the trigger rule measured it for #20332); the dogfood fixture `packages/qa/dogfood/test/fixtures/webhook-materialization-fixture.ts` (boots without realtime on purpose) is converted or declared, not deleted; the example apps' `requires` re-checked (`examples/app-showcase` already carries both tokens).
> - ⛔ No token implied or auto-added; ⛔ the activation door is unchanged (A′ was not taken on #24910).

## What changed

- `packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts`: `validateWebhookCapability`, the third declared-capability refusal, follows the `validateTriggerCapability` precedent exactly. It runs right after the trigger check and throws `StackWebhookCapabilityRequiredError` (`code: 'STACK_WEBHOOK_CAPABILITY_REQUIRED'`, `status: 422`, the `StackRefusalError` envelope) with the header `defineStack webhook capability validation failed (N issues):` and one `issues` entry per declared webhook. Each entry names the webhook, the missing token or tokens, and a prescription that is the whole fix for the `requires` it was given:
  - `realtime` present, `webhooks` missing: add `'webhooks'`;
  - `webhooks` present, `realtime` missing: add `'realtime'`;
  - neither (an absent `requires` included): add both, `['webhooks', 'realtime']`.
- Every declared webhook counts, `isActive: false` included. Unlike a retired flow, an inactive declaration is one activation-door write away from being switched on (the ledger row overrides the declared `isActive`, ADR-0131 D6), and the switch would then deliver nothing. Only the top-level `webhooks:` collection is read, the one the declared-webhook reader dispatches. Nothing is implied or added; `strict: false` skips the judgement by contract, as for every sibling.
- `packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts`: the new code is registered under `@objectstack/spec` beside the other `STACK_*` rows, with `door: 'none'` on their reading. The generated `content/docs/references/api/error-code-ledger.mdx` and `contract.mdx` are regenerated (`check:generated --fix`, which proved only those stale).
- `content/docs/automation/webhooks.mdx` §3.0 now says that such a stack is **refused**, names `'webhooks'` and `'realtime'`, says that every door stops with the same sentence, and says that the boot `error` remains for a host that wires a stack by hand.
- Changeset `.changeset/24997-webhook-capability-required.md`: `@objectstack/spec` minor, BREAKING banner, `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, the `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)` marker. Same shape as the 24813 changeset.

## Producers measured and fixed

| producer (tree `3b3830ca22`) | declares a webhook | `requires` | action |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `examples/app-showcase` | yes (`allWebhooks`) | carries `webhooks` and `realtime` | none; still loads |
| `examples/app-crm`, `app-todo`, `app-multi-package`, `embed-objectql` | no (`app-crm` names webhooks in a comment only) | n/a | none |
| `create-objectstack` blank template | no | `['automation', 'triggers']` | none; refused once a webhook is added, which is the point |
| `packages/qa/dogfood/test/fixtures/webhook-materialization-fixture.ts` | yes | absent | **declared**, see below |
| `packages/spec/src/stack-duplicate-entry.test.ts` webhook row | yes | absent | row context now carries `requires: ['webhooks', 'realtime']` |
| `packages/qa/dogfood/test/webhook-meta-door-credential-redaction.dogfood.test.ts` (landed on `main` after the branch point) | yes | absent | **declared via `strict: false`**, because its "without plugin-webhooks" composition is what the redactor pins need. Same choice as the materialization fixture. Commit `779ed238e5` |

Search used to find producers: every file that calls `defineStack` / `bootStack` / `composeStacks` and names `webhooks`, plus `defineWebhook` and `webhooks: [` repo-wide. The plugin-webhooks tests build declarations through `DeclaredWebhookSource`, never through `defineStack`, so they are unaffected.

**The dogfood fixture is declared, not converted.** It is now built with `defineStack(..., { strict: false })`, and a docblock says why. The proof exists to show that the declared-webhook reader binds on the data engine alone, with NO realtime service. If the fixture declared the pair, `bootStack` would mount realtime the way `serve` does, and a reader re-gated behind the dispatch prerequisites would then pass unseen. So the fixture models the one composition `defineStack` cannot reach: a hand-wired host. That is the population the boot `error` of #24946 serves. The precedent for a dogfood fixture built `strict: false` on purpose is `flow-node-config-values-at-registration.dogfood.test.ts`. Its second consumer, `wall-declared-webhook-deployment-wide.dogfood.test.ts`, hand-wires realtime and is unaffected. Both suites pass.

**Cloud's `resolveCapabilityDependencies`: NOT MEASURED.** Reason: the `cloud` repository is not in this container. The refusal sits in `defineStack`, so the cloud runtime refuses with the same sentence on any stack it loads through the producer. Whether its resolver implies `realtime` from `webhooks` changes nothing here, because no token is implied by ruling.

## The doors, measured (scaffold-shaped project, `requires: ['automation', 'triggers']` plus one declared webhook; CLI from source, `bin/run-dev.js`)

| `requires` | `os validate` | `os build --json` | `os dev --no-watch --fresh` |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `['automation', 'triggers']` | exit 1, `--json` `"code": "STACK_WEBHOOK_CAPABILITY_REQUIRED"`, finding: `webhook 'blank_note_changed' is declared but `requires` does not include 'webhooks' or 'realtime'` | exit 1, `"success": false`, `"code": "STACK_WEBHOOK_CAPABILITY_REQUIRED"` | exit 1 at `Loading objectstack.config.ts...`, same header and finding |
| `[..., 'webhooks']` | exit 1, finding names `'realtime'` | not run | not run |
| `[..., 'realtime']` | exit 1, finding names `'webhooks'` | not run | not run |
| `['automation', 'triggers', 'webhooks', 'realtime']` (CONTROL) | exit 0 | exit 0, `"success": true` | `Server is ready`, `/api/v1/health` 200, `WebhookOutboxPlugin` and `RealtimeServicePlugin` in the plugin list; stopped by its recorded PID |

An app's `bootStack` tests hit the same refusal at import, because the throw is in `defineStack` itself.

## Tests (pinned arms, control, ablation)

- New `packages/spec/src/stack-webhook-capability.test.ts`. It pins: the three arms (no `webhooks`, no `realtime`, both missing; for both missing, `requires` of `['automation', 'triggers']`, `[]` and absent), each with `code`, `status: 422`, the header, one `issues` entry and the finding text naming the webhook and the token(s); the CONTROL (the scaffold tokens plus the pair, the pair in either order, among other tokens); each prescription applied once is accepted; no token is implied (an accepted stack keeps the `requires` it declared); a stack with no webhook owes nothing; an inactive declaration still owes the pair; every webhook reported, one entry each; the map form; the trigger sibling reports first; `strict: false` skips.
- `stack-refusal-envelopes.test.ts`: a webhook row (refused + accepted control); the census is now nine sites and nine distinct codes. `stack-conversions-record.test.ts`: a webhook row; its census is now nine codes.
- **Ablation, red:** `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced the call `const webhookErrors = validateWebhookCapability(data);` with an empty list. The tool's own on-disk evidence: anchor 1 to 0, blob `3d8624dc4fa1` to `5898d7c8a60e`. With the call gone, the three spec files gave **18 failed / 76 passed**. Restore: blob equals HEAD `3d8624dc4fa1` and `git diff HEAD` is empty. No dist rebuild was needed, because these tests import `./stack.zod` from source.

## Verification

- **Resumed after a container restart:** merged `origin/main` `63085c3806`. Regenerated `content/docs/references/api/automation-api.mdx` (a page added on `main` that lists every error code), commit `e69078f0d1`. At `779ed238e5`: spec `check:generated` up to date, spec tests 21446 passed, spec `test:repo` 1237 passed, the three webhook-declaring dogfood files 24 of 24 passed, and `dispatch-gates --ran` shows 116 derived and 116 run. Report comment `6309741302` on #24997.

Run at `5107a88d13` (before the `origin/main` merge) unless stated otherwise:

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: 703/704 files passed on the first run. The one failure was the conversions-record census (`8` to `9`), fixed; the four affected files then gave 232/232. `test:repo`: 72 files / 1236 tests passed. `typecheck`: passed (`check:test-typecheck: OK`). `check:generated`: all 14 artifacts up to date after `--fix` regenerated the two reference pages.
- `@objectstack/dogfood`: `webhook-materialization.dogfood.test.ts` and `wall-declared-webhook-deployment-wide.dogfood.test.ts`, 9/9 passed.
- `@objectstack/cli` `--project unit`: 313/316 files passed. The 3 failures (`published-subpath-console.pin`, `published-subpath-hook-body.pin`, `scaffold-emission-typechecks`) read packed `.d.ts`, and an `OS_SKIP_DTS` closure build had removed them (TS7016 "Could not find a declaration file"). After a full declaration build of `@objectstack/cli...`, the three files gave 42/42. Integration layer: declared to CI (this diff touches no cli file).
- Lint: `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the 7 touched `.ts` files gave 7 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings. Population: all 7 resolve a config (`--print-config`). Invariance: `eslint.config.mjs` enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`), so this diff cannot move the verdict on any untouched file. Repo-wide `pnpm lint` belongs to CI.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 116 families derived at `5107a88d13`, all 116 run, all exit 0. Seven of them first answered PREREQUISITE NOT MET because of the same skip-DTS build, and gave exit 0 on re-run after the declaration build: `check:api-surface`, `check:dual-source-exports`, `check:entry-nameability`, `check:exported-any`, `check:skill-examples`, `check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`.
- After merging `origin/main` (14 commits, file-disjoint from this diff): spec build + `check:generated` + spec `test` were re-run on the merge head; see the report comment for that reading.

## Acceptance notes

- Text-mode `os validate` and `os dev` print the refusal's message, header and finding, but not the `code`. That is how every `STACK_*` refusal surfaces today, the trigger sibling included; the code is on `--json` (`os validate --json`, `os build --json`). Carrier: none. The CLI's text renderer is not this card's surface.
- `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md`, the capability table, still reads `webhooks`, absent, "nothing delivered outbound", and does not name `realtime`. Since this change, a stack in that state is refused with the fix named, so this is no silent trap. `skills/**` is governed (Tier H) and outside the claim's file surface, so it is not edited here. Carrier: none.
- Contract review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` is owed on this PR (the claim and the ruling both say so).
